task:
Create a Job named 'neb-new-job' in namespace 'neptune' with specific completion requirements.

Create namespace 'neptune' if it does not exist.

Job requirements:
  - Name: neb-new-job
  - Namespace: neptune
  - Image: busybox:1.31.0
  - Container name: neb-new-job-container
  - Command: ['/bin/sh', '-c', 'sleep 2 && echo done']
  - completions: 3      (run job pod 3 times total)
  - parallelism: 2      (run 2 job pods at a time)
  - Labels on Job AND pod template:
      id: awesome-job
  - Save the YAML manifest to /opt/course/3/job.yaml

Verify:
  kubectl get job neb-new-job -n neptune
  kubectl get job neb-new-job -n neptune -o jsonpath='{.spec.completions}'
  # Expected: 3
  kubectl get job neb-new-job -n neptune -o jsonpath='{.spec.parallelism}'
  # Expected: 2
hints: kubectl create job neb-new-job --image=busybox:1.31.0 -n neptune --dry-run=client -o yaml
Add completions: 3 and parallelism: 2 under spec:
detailed_hints: kubectl create job neb-new-job --image=busybox:1.31.0 -n neptune -- /bin/sh -c 'sleep 2 && echo done' --dry-run=client -o yaml > /opt/course/3/job.yaml
Add labels under spec.template.metadata.labels: id: awesome-job
Also add labels on Job metadata: labels: {id: awesome-job}
